data-emotion="css 1iyoj2o"></style><div class="css-1iyoj2o"><style data-emotion="css 1ib3ewf"></style><h2 class="css-1ib3ewf">Policy and notes</h2><style data-emotion="css x1cmhs"></style><div class="css-x1cmhs"><style data-emotion="css syv2kv"></style><div class="css-syv2kv"><h3 class="css-1ib3ewf">Payment schedule</h3><p data-testid="text" class="css-1skencn">50% of the total amount is due at time of reservation.</p><p data-testid="text" class="css-1skencn">The remaining amount is to be paid 30 day(s) before arrival.</p></div><div class="css-syv2kv"><h3 class="css-1ib3ewf">Cancellation Policy</h3><p data-testid="text" class="css-1skencn">All paid prepayments are non-refundable.</p></div></div><h3 class="css-1ib3ewf">Security deposit</h3><p data-testid="text" class="css-1skencn">No security deposit is due.</p><h3 class="css-1ib3ewf">Notes</h3><style data-emotion="css zv7iih"></style><div class="css-zv7iih"><p>All rates are per apartment per night in $ US, 10% Gov. tax is to be added</p>
<p>All rates are calculated on the following occupancies: </p>
<p>1 Bedroom units & Studios: max. 2 persons;  2 bedroom units: max. 4 persons </p>
<p><br></p>
<p>FORMS OF PAYMENT</p>
<p>In our efforts to keep our rates as low as possible, all rates published on our website are based on payment via local bank transfer. Those rates also apply for cash payments.</p>
<p>We offer other bank transfer options which details can be provided depending on a customers location. Please inquire by email for further details. </p>
<p>We also accept payments via credit card, Master, Visa or American Express for which a 4% fee will be added to the bill..</p>
<p>Normal occupancy in a two bedroom unit is four people maximum and the one bedroom units are meant to accommodate two persons max. Exceptions are possible in certain houses and can only be granted by the property manager. Please always indicate the number of people in your party with your reservation request. The max. no. of persons given in a booking confirmation can not be exceeded, unless it has been authorized by our Property Manager.</p>
<p>As there are units which can accommodate additional persons, any additional person in any of our units cost $ US 50 + 10% Tax per night. An additional person in a unit are subject to management's permission. </p>
<p>All rates are based on a limited maid service as explained on our Maid Service page on our website</p>
<p>Cleaning fee charges: $ US 50 one time fee for our 1 bedroom units and studios; $ US 80 one time fee for our 2 bedroom units. This will be calculated in your final total and included in your booking confirmation. </p>
<p>For a more extensive maid or cook service, an additional charge will apply. </p>
<p>Special note:</p>
<p>Confirmed bookings are not affected by rate changes.  </p>
<p>A Tourism Levy of $ US 4.40 per bedroom, per night is to be paid upon arrival.</p>
<p><strong>CANCELLATION CONDITIONS</strong></p>
<p>First of all we wish to recommend to take travel insurance for the full amount of the rental fee. Just in case you need to cancel your booking we will always try to recover days of a canceled booking and if this can be achieved, corresponding refunds will be granted.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div data-testid="component-resolver.Footer" class="css-jbvua0"><style data-emotion="css 6g5n9d"></style><footer></footer></div></div><style data-emotion="css xap83t"></style><iframe title="Cookie consent storage" data-testid="widgets.cookie-consent-bridge.iframe" src="https://checkout.lodgify.com/inchcape-seaside-villas/cookie-consent-bridge" class="css-xap83t"></iframe></div></div></div>
